function: no_learning (p. 2): BS active and RIS passive beamforming are designed by SCA-ADMM iterative optimization; FL only trains the application model (CNN, p. 9) that the downlink serves.
notes: PDF is the paper of the DOI: p. 1 holds the title and "Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/JIOT.2025.3631734". Excluded as no_learning. The physical-layer function, the BS precoder and RIS phase shifts that maximize energy efficiency, is solved by classical optimization, p. 2: "we propose an effective iterative optimization framework based on the synergy of successive convex approximation (SCA) and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)"; Algorithm 1 (p. 8) updates the beamformer and the phases with ADMM closed forms. Learning is only the application that the link serves, p. 4: "the BS utilizes spatial multiplexing to simultaneously transmit the global model parameters to K users", and the FL model is a CNN (p. 9). The exemption for FL over the air does not apply, because aggregation is digital at the server with fixed channel-norm weights (eqs. 3-4), p. 3: "the BS will assign different weight parameters to aggregate the gradient according to the channel quality"; there is no over-the-air computation. The FL-aware part is a gradient-norm stopping criterion (p. 5), not a learned beamformer, and all compared beamformers are non-learned (SCA, P-BF [6], RCG [11], random phase shift; Table II, p. 10). Even if the FL model were taken as the learned element, the work would be excluded under function, since digital FL without over-the-air computation is outside area 7.
